learning_outcomes.text: Model a system composed of several solids.
Obtain the equations governing the movements of the different parts of a system, assuming the solids are undeformable.
Apply the Fundamental Principle of Dynamics to obtain equations of motion.
Apply the Principle of Virtual Work (d'Alembert's Principle) to obtain equations of motion, including Lagrange's equations.
Dimension mechanical systems more effectively, avoiding over-dimensioning in terms of material and motorization.
Favor innovation by facilitating the use of numerical simulation, thereby limiting the need for physical experimentation.

syllabus_topics: Principle of Virtual Works - LAGRANGE Equations
